result.description:
On behalf of our client, we are seeking a full-time experienced IT Network Support Administrator to manage and support our clients' network environment and day-to-day IT infrastructure. This role will play a key part in keeping systems running smoothly, resolving technical issues, and supporting the ongoing stability and security of the business’ network operations.
Key Responsibilities:

In this role, you will:
• Maintain and support the organisation’s network environment, including servers, routers, switches and associated systems
• Monitor system performance and respond to network or connectivity issues in a timely manner
• Troubleshoot faults and outages, identifying root causes and implementing practical solutions
• Manage user access, permissions and system configurations in line with internal policies
• Assist with system updates, upgrades and routine maintenance to ensure network security and reliability
• Keep accurate records of network configurations, assets and changes
• Work with external IT providers or vendors where required to support system improvements or issue resolution
• Provide support to internal users on network-related issues and assist with general IT queries

Qualifications, Skills & Experience
• A Bachelor’s degree or higher qualification in Information Technology, Computer Science or a related discipline; or
• At least 5 years' practical experience and/or relevant industry certifications demonstrating capability in network administration and support
• Proven experience in network administration, IT support, or a similar infrastructure-focused role
• Strong understanding of network environments, including configuration, maintenance and troubleshooting
• Experience supporting users and resolving system or connectivity issues
• Sound understanding of system security, access control and data protection practices
• Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate documentation
• Good organisational skills and the ability to manage competing tasks
• Clear communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues to non-technical users

Desirable
• Relevant certifications (e.g. Cisco, CompTIA, Microsoft or similar)
• Exposure to cloud-based or hybrid environments
• Experience working in a small-to-medium business IT environment or with external IT providers
 
Salary: $90,000 - $110,000 per annum (excluding superannuation)
